## People

A small group with a wide reach: psychologists, statisticians, and computer scientists working on one set of questions. Click a person for their profile and publications.

### Graduate Students

Students join the lab through the Clinical Psychological Science (CPS) and Brain, Behavior, and Quantitative Science (BBQ) doctoral programs.

:::{#students}
:::

```{r assistants}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
assistants <- read.csv("people/assistants.csv")
if (nrow(assistants) > 0) {   # the section appears only when the lab has research assistants
  cat('

### Research Assistants

<ul class="ra-list">', paste0('<li><span class="name">', sub("^(.*), (.*)$", "\\2 \\1", assistants$Name), '</span><span class="meta">', assistants$Role, " · since ", sub("^\\d{4}[a-c] \\((\\w+)\\)$", "\\1", assistants$Started), " ", substr(assistants$Started, 1, 4), '</span></li>', collapse = ""), '</ul>', sep = "")
}
```

### Alumni

```{r alumni-count}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
al <- read.csv("people/alumni.csv")
cat(sprintf('<p>%d people have been part of the lab since 2020, from honors students to a postdoctoral fellow.</p>
<p><a class="alumni-link" href="people/alumni.html">See all alumni &rarr;</a></p>', nrow(al)))
```
